title: The Lantern Moth
statement: Long ago, when the night was still unlit, a small moth mistook the first star for a lamp and flew toward it for a thousand years, and the sky, charmed by her mistake, pinned her wings in silver so she could rest. Every autumn she stirs, tracing her seven stars in slow loops, and anyone who has ever chased something just out of reach may find that one wing flutters back.
